question: What effect on age and death is produced by abstaining from food by day?
premises: Non-eating by day is specified as the means.
Age and death are named together.
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will go beyond age and death.
uncertainties: The exact sense of gamiṣyate with vayo-mṛtyuṃ may mean overcoming or passing beyond.
plain_english: By not eating during the day, one will overcome age and death.
